zh.title: 澳洲航空QantasLink首架E190抵達伯斯展開機隊更新
zh.summary: QantasLink首架E190抵達伯斯；展開F100替換；預計2027年營運。
body: 澳洲航空（Qantas）旗下區域航空公司QantasLink迎來首架巴西航空工業E190（ICAO機型代碼E190）客機。該架國籍標誌VH-E9A的客機於2026年9月7日飛抵西澳大利亞伯斯，完成自英國諾里奇出發、歷時約20小時的跨國飛行，途中曾在保加利亞、塔吉克、印度、馬來西亞及西澳大利亞布魯姆進行加油停靠。
此架客機為QantasLink引進最多14架中古巴西航空工業E190計畫中的首架客機，旨在逐步替換在西澳大利亞地區營運的福克F100機隊。根據規劃，該客機經檢修與客艙升級後，預計於2027年1月正式投入商業營運，服務當地礦業包機與區域定期航線。
首架引進的E190客機命名為「Exmouth」，承襲了以往以西澳大利亞地名命名的傳統。新客機採用100座配置與2-2座位佈局，配備具備可調式頭靠的新型座椅、USB-A與USB-C充電插孔及個人裝置支架，並導入無線網路系統與Qantas Economy Plus艙等，提供乘客更寬敞的腿部空間與優先登機服務。
為配合新機隊引進，QantasLink計劃在今年底前完成約70名機師、空服員及機務工程師的培訓，累計提供1.8萬小時的訓練課程。隨着轉型計畫推進，預計未來將有超過600名人員接受該機型的操作與維護訓練。
在性能表現方面，巴西航空工業E190在滿載條件下的航程達到4,537公里，相較於現行福克F100的3,170公里增加約1,367公里。更高的燃油效率與更遠的航程，將為航空公司在西澳大利亞廣闊的區域網路中提供更彈性的航線佈局與營運能力。

en.title: QantasLink Receives First Embraer E190 in Perth to Begin Fokker F100 Fleet Replacement
en.summary: QantasLink received its first Embraer E190 in Perth to replace its Fokker F100 fleet from 2027.
body: QantasLink has received its first Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) aircraft in Perth, Western Australia, on September 7, 2026. The 100-seat regional jet, registered VH-E9A, arrived following a 20-hour delivery flight from Norwich in the United Kingdom, making planned refueling stops in Bulgaria, Tajikistan, India, Malaysia, and Broome before reaching Perth.

The aircraft is the first of up to 14 mid-life Embraer E190 jets that will progressively replace QantasLink's aging Fokker F100 fleet across Western Australian operations. The fleet renewal program supports both regional scheduled services and resource sector charter operations, with the first E190 scheduled to enter commercial passenger service in January 2027.

Named Exmouth, continuing the airline's tradition of naming aircraft after Western Australian destinations, the jet features a refreshed cabin with a two-by-two seat layout. Customer enhancements include new seats with adjustable headrests, USB-A and USB-C power sockets, personal device holders, onboard Wi-Fi streaming, and Qantas Economy Plus offering increased legroom and priority access.

Ahead of entry into service, QantasLink is conducting 18,000 hours of training for approximately 70 pilots, cabin crew members, and maintenance engineers by the end of the year. As the operational deployment reaches full scale, the airline plans to train more than 600 personnel on the new aircraft type.

The Embraer E190 offers a published full-payload range of 4,537 kilometers (2,450 nautical miles), representing an increase of roughly 1,367 kilometers compared to the 3,170-kilometer range of the Fokker F100. Powered by twin GE CF34-10E turbofan engines, the aircraft provides improved fuel efficiency, lower noise levels, and greater operational flexibility for long-distance regional routes.

zh.title: 日本連續五日緊急升空戰機 攔截中國Y-9情報偵察機
zh.summary: 日本自衛隊連續五日對中國Y-9偵察機緊急升空；未侵入日本領空
body: 日本防衛省統合幕僚監部最新公布的監測資料顯示，航空自衛隊於2026年9月3日至9月7日期間，連續五天針對出現在東海空域的中國軍用Y-9情報偵察機，緊急升空戰機實施對應。防衛省各相應區域航空方面隊在掌握目標動向後，均即時派遣戰機進行監控與跟蹤。
統合幕僚監部於2026年9月7日發布的最新通報指出，當天下午一架中國Y-9情報偵察機自中國大陸方向飛來，先飛抵長崎縣男女群島以南空域，隨後折向西南方向飛行，並在沖繩本島附近改變航向往東北飛行，之後再次於男女群島以南轉向，最終返航飛回中國大陸方向。該次攔截行動由西部航空方面隊及其他單位共同派機執行。
防衛省記錄顯示，前四天的飛行航線與9月7日的路線極為相似。在9月5日的事件中，Y-9偵察機同樣由中國大陸方向接近並於沖繩本島附近轉向，隨後於男女群島附近再次變向後離去，該次任務由南西航空方面隊負責對應；其餘四天則均由管轄男女群島空域的西部航空方面隊執行緊急升空。防衛省強調，相關通報中均未記錄到任何侵入日本領空的情況。
此外，統合幕僚監部於9月7日發布的另一份通報記錄，一架俄羅斯Il-20情報偵察機於9月5日自大陸方向經鄂霍次克海進入太平洋，並一路向南飛至宮城縣沖空域後折返，再經鄂霍次克海返回日本海，北部航空方面隊對此緊急升空戰機監控。統計顯示，在截至2026年3月31日的2025財政年度中，自衛隊共執行595次緊急升空，其中約61%係針對中國航空器。

en.title: Japan scrambles fighter jets five consecutive days against Chinese Y-9 spy aircraft
en.summary: Japan Air Self-Defense Force scrambled fighters for Chinese Y-9 aircraft over East China Sea five consecutive days
body: Japan’s Joint Staff recorded a Chinese Y-9 intelligence-gathering aircraft flying over the East China Sea for five consecutive days from September 3 to September 7, 2026, prompting the Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF) to scramble fighter jets in response each time, according to official notices.

A notice published on September 7, 2026, detailed the latest flight path, describing a single Y-9 arriving from the Chinese mainland that afternoon. The aircraft flew south of the Danjo Islands in Nagasaki Prefecture, turned southwest, reversed course off Okinawa Island to track northeast, and changed heading again south of the Danjo Islands before returning toward mainland China. Fighters from the Western Air Defense Force responded alongside other units.

Similar flight paths were recorded on the four preceding days. On September 5, 2026, the Y-9 approached from the mainland, turned off Okinawa Island, flew northeast, and changed course off the Danjo Islands before exiting the area. While the Southwestern Air Defense Force handled the scramble on September 5, the Western Air Defense Force managed the responses on the remaining four days. None of the official notices reported any incursion into Japanese territorial airspace.

A separate notice issued on September 7, 2026, documented a Russian Il-20 intelligence-gathering aircraft flying from the mainland through the Sea of Okhotsk into the Pacific on September 5, 2026. The Russian aircraft traveled south to waters off Miyagi Prefecture before reversing direction and returning to the Sea of Japan via the Sea of Okhotsk, triggering a scramble by Northern Air Defense Force fighters. Official figures for fiscal year 2025, which ended March 31, 2026, show JASDF executed 595 scrambles in total, with approximately 61% directed against Chinese aircraft.

zh.title: 瑞士航空計劃將最後一架空中巴士A340客機捐贈予交通博物館
zh.summary: 瑞士航空計劃於2028年初將最後一架A340客機捐贈予盧森交通博物館。
body: 瑞士國際航空（SWISS）目前正與瑞士交通博物館密切合作，計劃將該航空公司最後一架空中巴士A340-300客機保存於盧森（Lucerne）的博物館中，作為永久性的戶外展品。根據雙方的規劃，一旦該客機達到其營運壽命的終點，將會被捐贈給這家位於盧森的博物館，並預計展示於航空航天展覽館前的戶外區域。航空公司表示，希望能於2028年初完成該客機的安置工作。
空中巴士A340-300客機多年來一直是瑞士國際航空長途機隊的重要成員。作為該航空公司機隊中最後一款四引擎機型，其退役將象徵著一個時代的終結。瑞士國際航空執行長 Jens Fehlinger 表示，A340客機多年來將瑞士與世界各地連結在一起，其本身已成為瑞士航空歷史的一部分。博物館方面則計劃在客機內部打造遊客體驗設施，使其成為航空與太空展覽的新核心展品。
然而，這項計劃仍面臨重大的技術與物流挑戰。這架重達約125噸的客機必須從蘇黎世機場（ZRH）經由陸路運送至盧森的博物館，並精確定位於館區內。此一極具挑戰性的運送過程需要進行詳細的可行性研究、專門的運輸方案、博物館場地的結構改造，以及與瑞士相關主管機關的密切協調。瑞士交通博物館館長 Martin Ettlinger 坦言，將如此龐大體積的飛機運送到盧森是一項極其巨大且高度複雜的工程。
除了物流之外，資金籌措同樣面臨考驗。雖然瑞士國際航空將免費捐贈該客機，但運送、場地結構改造以及艙內參觀體驗的建置成本均須由博物館承擔。目前預估總費用高達個位數的百萬級，資金預計主要來自基金會、資助人及企業贊助。由瑞士交通博物館協會主席兼瑞士國際航空前執行長 Christoph Franz 領導的籌款委員會已展開接觸。該項目必須在2026年底前確保資金到位，方能繼續推進。

en.title: SWISS Plans to Donate Last Airbus A340-300 to Swiss Museum of Transport
en.summary: SWISS plans to donate its last Airbus A340-300 to Switzerland's transport museum by early 2028.
body: Swiss International Air Lines (SWISS) and the Swiss Museum of Transport are collaborating on a project to preserve one of the airline's last Airbus A340-300 aircraft. Under current plans, once the four-engined aircraft reaches the end of its operational life, it will be donated to the museum in Lucerne to serve as a permanent outdoor exhibit in front of the Aviation and Space Travel Hall. The airline stated that it hopes to have the aircraft positioned at the museum by early 2028.

The retirement of the Airbus A340-300 will mark the end of an era for SWISS, as it is the last remaining four-engined aircraft type in the carrier's fleet. SWISS CEO Jens Fehlinger remarked that the aircraft has connected Switzerland with the world for many years, becoming a significant part of Swiss aviation history. The museum plans to transform the interior of the aircraft into a walkthrough visitor experience, making it a new centerpiece of its permanent exhibition alongside a former Swissair Convair 990 'Coronado'.

However, the initiative faces significant technical and logistical challenges. The aircraft weighs approximately 125 tons and must be transported overland from Zurich Airport (ZRH) to the museum grounds in Lucerne. This complex undertaking will require detailed feasibility studies, specialized transportation solutions, structural modifications to the museum site, and close coordination with Swiss authorities. Martin Ettlinger, Director of the Swiss Museum of Transport, described the project as an enormous and highly complex task.

The project also requires substantial financial backing. While SWISS is donating the aircraft itself, the museum must cover the costs of transport, site preparation, and the interior visitor exhibit. The total cost is currently estimated at a high single-digit million figure. A fundraising committee led by Christoph Franz, President of the Swiss Museum of Transport Association, is seeking sponsors. Funding must be secured by the end of 2026, and a final decision will depend on transportation, permitting, and complete financing.

zh.title: Breeze正式退役最後一架E190客機轉用全A220機隊
zh.summary: Breeze正式退役巴西航空工業E190；將全面轉型為空中巴士A220機隊
body: 根據航空媒體《Simple Flying》於2026年9月8日的報導，總部位於美國猶他州的航空公司Breeze已正式退役其最後一架巴西航空工業E190（ICAO機型代碼E190）客機。此項舉措標誌著該航空公司正式步入全新時代，並將全面過渡至由空中巴士（Airbus）A220客機組成的單一機隊。
在此之前，飛機製造商巴西航空工業公司（Embraer）於2026年9月3日向巴西的Azul Linhas Aéreas交付了其第2,000架E-Jet系列飛機，該飛機為E195-E2機型。E-Jet系列客機於2004年首度投入服務，目前已為全球60多個國家的90多家航空公司提供服務，累計飛行時間約4,800萬小時，並載運了超過28.5億名旅客。

en.title: Breeze Retires Its Last Embraer E190 To Transition To All-Airbus A220 Fleet
en.summary: Breeze retires its final Embraer E190 to transition to an all Airbus A220 fleet.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying on September 8, 2026, Utah-based airline Breeze has officially retired its last Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) aircraft. This operational transition officially moves the carrier to an all-Airbus A220 fleet, representing a new era for the airline.

Separately, on September 3, 2026, manufacturer Embraer delivered its 2,000th E-Jet, an E195-E2, to Brazil's Azul Linhas Aéreas. The E-Jet family originally entered service in 2004 and now serves more than 90 airlines in over 60 countries, amassing approximately 48 million flight hours and carrying over 2.85 billion passengers globally.

zh.title: 聖地牙哥蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場（MYF）賽斯納飛機墜毀釀2死
zh.summary: 一架賽斯納小型飛機於聖地牙哥MYF機場墜毀起火，造成機上兩人死亡。
body: 一架賽斯納天鷹（Cessna Skyhawk）小型飛機於2026年9月7日傍晚，在美國加利福尼亞州聖地牙哥的蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場（MYF）跑道上發生墜毀並起火燃燒，事故造成機上兩名人員不幸死亡。根據聖地牙哥警察局的報告指出，警方的應變單位是在當地時間約17時20分接獲該起空難通報。事發當時正值美國勞工節假期，機場內多數店家與商業設施均處於關閉狀態。
聖地牙哥消防救援局副局長布萊恩·雷恩斯（Brian Raines）在出席當地媒體記者會時表示，救援人員趕抵現場時，飛機主體已遭受極為嚴重的毀損，導致救援人員完全無法從機艙內救出受困人員。雷恩斯隨後證實，機上的兩名人員均已宣告死亡，惟相關單位目前尚未公開死者的具體身份資訊。此外，消防單位亦強調火勢已得到控制，並無蔓延至墜機地點以外區域的風險，現場並已聯繫專業承包商針對跑道上洩漏的航空燃料進行清理。
根據現場目擊者的說法，一名當時在附近停車場高層觀看飛機起降的民眾向《洛杉磯時報》透露，該架飛機在準備進場降落時，機身似乎向右側傾斜，隨後機翼直接撞擊地面；在撞擊發生的數秒之內，飛機前部隨即冒出大火，且在撞擊前並未看見機身發出任何煙霧。另一方面，兩名在附近機庫工作的目擊者則向媒體表示，他們當時聽到巨響並目擊火勢迅速蔓延，兩人雖隨即持滅火器前往救援，但火勢在約90秒內便將整架飛機吞噬。
事發之後，美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）已立即下令關閉蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場，目前尚未設定恢復營運的時間表。雷恩斯對此說明，機場重啟的決策將與美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）及機場管理當局共同協調後決定，並視調查程序所需的時間而定。目前國家運輸安全委員會已接管並主導整起墜機事故原因的調查工作。據瞭解，蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場為通用航空設施，提供私人、企業、包機、空中救護及飛行訓練等多項服務。

en.title: Two Killed in Cessna Skyhawk Crash at San Diego Montgomery-Gibbs Airport
en.summary: A Cessna Skyhawk crashed at San Diego Montgomery-Gibbs Airport, leaving two dead and prompting an NTSB investigation.
body: A small Cessna Skyhawk aircraft crashed and caught fire on a runway at Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport (MYF) in San Diego, California, on the evening of September 7, 2026, leaving two people dead on board. According to a report issued by the San Diego Police Department, emergency responders received notice of the crash at approximately 17:20 local time. The fatal incident occurred on the Labor Day holiday, a time when most businesses and shops operating at the general aviation facility were closed.

Speaking at a news conference with local media, San Diego Fire-Rescue Assistant Chief Brian Raines stated that the aircraft sustained catastrophic damage before emergency crews could reach the scene, rendering it impossible to extricate anyone from the wreckage. Raines confirmed that both individuals aboard the plane died in the accident, though authorities have not yet publicly released their identities. Officials emphasized that there was no risk of the fire spreading beyond the crash site, and a specialist contractor was summoned to clear spilled aviation fuel from the runway.

Witnesses near the airfield described the moments leading up to the impact. A resident watching flights from the top floor of a nearby parking garage told the Los Angeles Times that the aircraft appeared to tilt sharply to the right during its landing approach before its wing struck the ground. According to the witness, the front section of the plane caught fire within seconds of impact, with no visible smoke preceding the collision. Additionally, two workers from a nearby hangar reported hearing a loud explosion before attempting to extinguish the rapidly spreading flames, which completely engulfed the aircraft in about 90 seconds.

Following the crash, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) immediately shut down Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport, with no initial timetable established for its reopening. Assistant Chief Raines noted that decisions regarding the airport's reopening will be made in coordination with the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) and airport officials, contingent upon the requirements of the ongoing safety inquiry. The NTSB has assumed the lead role in investigating the cause of the accident. Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport serves as a regional general aviation hub supporting private, corporate, charter, medical transport, flight training, and light cargo operations.
